Population increased in Staffordshire Moorlands

The estimated population of Staffordshire Moorlands in 2024 was 96,651 usual residents, a rise of 0.6% since 2023.

This meant that Staffordshire Moorlands' rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Staffordshire Moorlands increased by 0.7%.

Over this slightly longer period, Staffordshire Moorlands was also among the 20% slowest growing local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Staffordshire Moorlands

The average (median) age stayed at 50.1 years between 2023 and 2024.

sections.content:
Staffordshire Moorlands is an area that is classed as intermediate urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Staffordshire Moorlands' population of 96,651 usual residents was made up of:

  • 14,857 people aged 0 to 15 years, (15.4%)
  • 55,635 people aged 16 to 64 years, (57.6%)
  • 26,159 people aged 65 years and over, (27.1%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Staffordshire Moorlands has a higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (27.1% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Staffordshire Moorlands, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Staffordshire Moorlands
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Staffordshire Moorlands, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 464 people (-0.5%). In total, there were 699 births and 1,163 deaths in Staffordshire Moorlands.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 865 (0.9%). There were 4,567 people entering the area and 3,702 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Staffordshire Moorlands' population of 132 (0.1%) as a result of 179 people entering the area and 47 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Staffordshire Moorlands was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Staffordshire Moorlands in mid-2023 is 96,095.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 78 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 232 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 310 people.
